params.value: ($1), who needs the tutorial? Click on the players or select from the middle.

preset.text:
Two teams take turns. Each round, the active team's Psychic sees a secret position (1-10) on a spectrum card — e.g. Hot vs Cold.

The Psychic gives ONE word or phrase as a clue to hint at where the target falls on the spectrum.

Your team votes on where the target is (1 = far left, 10 = far right).

The other team guesses Left or Right of your answer before the reveal.

Scoring: Exact = 4 pts | Off by 1 = 3 pts | Off by 2 = 2 pts | Off by 3+ = 0 pts.
Correct counter-guess = 1 bonus pt for the opposing team.

The host decides when to end the game — highest score at that point wins!
